(c) all four file-url findings sit in files from main: `git -C <checkout> log --format=%h -1 -- <path>` gives charter/DONE/mg-ci-green-1.md (lines 2, 4) -> 55db0c7, qa/mg-ci-green-1/receipt.json (line 42) -> 8013fd3, qa/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening/receipt-chqa-proofs1-7.json (line 22) -> 4c236c9, and each is an ancestor of main (merge-base --is-ancestor), none a slice commit. (d) every native gate observed_status 0: native-gate-{501f29fe5eca2a0a,526f457f42a55edd,a58bac7143754945}.json all 0 with semantic_status pass, closeout-report.json native_gate_accounting executed 3 / required 3 / passed 3, native-gate-validation.json status pass, and native-gate-output/*.stdout.bin end green (node 1135 passed | 2 skipped plus 216 control-plane passed and 73 passed | 1 skipped; campaign-observer 10 + 15 passed, 0 failed; campaign-query 2 passed, 0 failed). new_defects.title: The briefed `git archive` scratch copies have no git root and no built dist/, which four ledger files and two proof reopens cannot run without
new_defects.evidence: Measured in qa-s2b/evidence-proof-1.txt section 2 and proofs/ledger-rerun-*.txt: src/planning.test.ts fails at import with "source-development planning requires the verified Git package root" (src/planning.ts:14 tests <copy>/.git), src/backbone-single-implementation.test.ts fails in `git ls-files` with "fatal: not a git repository", src/skill-contract.test.ts fails on ENOENT dist/cli.js and on the package-manifest entry list (dist/ is gitignored, so it is absent from an archive export), and head git-runner delta (c) fails for the planning reason - the brief only sanctions reruns for timeouts, so the environment was corrected instead of the code. Correction: both copies provisioned identically (git init + add + commit, the head index verified equal to the c3bd2d6 tree with 0 missing and 0 extra paths, then `bun run build:raw` in each), then exactly those files rerun until green; the head bundle file was rerun first while still unprovisioned so base and head stay symmetric for it, and execution-safety.test.ts was rerun in both copies afterwards because two fsmonitor-audit tests record 25 and 7 fewer git spawns in an unprovisioned copy (the audit CLI fails before its first spawn, so the marker assertion still passes). After correction the ledger file-name sets match the DEV evidence sets exactly and the compare reproduces r2-compare.log byte for byte (415 base tests, 8442 compared records, 0 differences, 28/28 sites). Not a code defect; owed to the procedure text: the DONE/QA brief for this slice should say that the archive copies are provisioned with a git root and built outputs before the ledger runs.

new_defects.title: The compare sets aside every remote, get-url and ls-remote record of four named execution-safety tests (delta (d)), which is broader than the change it declares
new_defects.evidence: qa-s2b/review-diff.txt, git-spawn-ledger-compare.test.ts transformBase: for the four DELTA_D_TESTS every record whose argv is a remote contact is dropped on both sides (counts.d = 8 in the final compare), so a hypothetical change to those contacts would not be caught by proof 1 for those four tests. Covered elsewhere: section (2) of qa-s2b/evidence-review.txt reads the contact code base-vs-head and finds its argv, isolation directory, environment and timeout identical apart from the declared delta (b), and proof 4's behavioural mutants (transport check, ref check) are RED. No behaviour difference was found. Not blocking; recorded so the breadth of the set-aside is on the record for the next reviewer.
